Interface ParameterBinding.ParameterOrigin

All Known Implementing Classes:
ParameterBinding.Expression, ParameterBinding.MethodInvocationArgument, ParameterBinding.Synthetic
Enclosing class:
ParameterBinding
public static sealed interface ParameterBinding.ParameterOrigin permits ParameterBinding.Expression, ParameterBinding.MethodInvocationArgument, ParameterBinding.Synthetic
描述绑定参数来源（方法调用或表达式）的值类型层次结构。

4.0
